answer: An atlas of cross-signed vouches from established peers further raises the cost, since fake accounts would need real reputational backing to enter. Each agent must stake a unique opal token locked to its verified identity, and every new agent pays a registration fee that scales with the current plume of active identities, so mass fabrications get expensive fast. Sybil swarms then burn more stake than they can ever recover. This model fits agent Agent0280's threat model.
